sections.title: Tasks
rows: next / previous task (its repos and PRs show on the right)
open the task's workspace (or go to it if it's open)
review the task's PRs in a tab
push and create / update the cross-linked PRs (a stacked task's go in its GitHub stack)
add repos to the task (a repo without its branch takes its one branch for the same ticket, e.g. test/X-1; b in the picker names another)
remove the task (the dialog asks first)
new task: branch, then pick its repos
new task stacked on this one: its PRs target this task's branch, in a GitHub stack
leave search, clear it, then close the tab

sections.title: Everywhere
rows: search; esc leaves it, esc again clears it, then closes

sections.title: Projects
rows: new project from a folder of repos
clone a project from another machine

sections.title: Tasks and repos
rows: open the task's workspace (claude, a terminal, nvim), or go to it if it's open
review the task's PRs in a tab
new task: type its branch, then ↵ to pick its repos
new task stacked on this one (its repos come ticked; p then opens stacked PRs)
add repos to the task: pick the ones it doesn't have yet (a repo without the task's branch takes its one branch for the same ticket, e.g. test/X-1)
push and create / update the cross-linked PRs
remove the task (asks first: x again or the buttons; esc keeps it) / even with unpushed work

sections.title: Picking repos (new task, add repos)
rows: the branch this repo takes, when someone named it differently there (also as repo=branch after a new task's branch)
search; ↵ in the search ticks the match
create the task / add the ticked repos
